name: vertical flag hold
description: A hold on a vertical pole with both arms straight and the body upright above the bottom hand. It builds the push and pull the human flag needs.
instructions: Grip a vertical pole with your top hand overhand and bottom hand underhand, wider than shoulders.
Jump up so your hips stack over your bottom hand and your legs point at the sky.
Pull with the top arm and push with the bottom arm.
Hold, then step down and switch your grip.
